verified_checks.hebcal_resilience: PASS — `loadHolidayWindows()` wraps fetch in try/catch and returns FALLBACK on error; only a single non-blocking console.warn surfaces ('Hebcal lookup failed, using static fallback'). Generic chips render unconditionally from `buildGenericChips()` (no network dependency), so 4-chip fallback contract holds even when Hebcal is unreachable.

critical_code_review_comments: holidayWindows.js fetches `thisYear` and `thisYear + 1` sequentially via `await`. Could be `Promise.all` for one fewer round-trip — micro-optimization, not blocking.

QuickChips.jsx: holiday chips don't gracefully handle the case where Hebcal returns shavuot/roshHashana = null AND a stale cache has fresh sukkot/pesach but null for the new keys. Current behavior: only sukkot+pesach show, which is the documented fallback — acceptable.

Cache key bump v1 → v2 is correct (prevents poisoning of new consumers). One small risk: if a Service Worker / CDN has the old static FALLBACK constant bundled (with only sukkot+pesach), `loadHolidayWindows` on Hebcal-failure may surface just 2 holiday chips on first paint, then 4 after the network call resolves — minor flicker that real users likely won't see.

Navigate `replace` on `/` ROUTE is correct, but if a user lands on `/` from an external referrer, their back button now exits the site entirely. That's the intended UX (Airbnb behavior), just noting the trade-off.

No regression: posthog-recorder.js's fetch wrapper logs a `Failed to fetch` for the Hebcal call in this preview environment occasionally — this is a posthog instrumentation artifact, NOT a true Hebcal failure (chips still resolve to correct Hebcal dates, proving the actual fetch succeeded). User-impact = zero.
seed_data_creation: none — localStorage key `mir_holiday_windows_v2` cleared before each measurement to force fresh Hebcal fetch
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both follow-ups ship clean. data-testids confirmed: root redirects to /stays with replace (no back-button leak to /), /home renders the legacy Home with home-search-band. Mobile (390x844) chips: stays-quick-chips and hero-quick-chips each contain 8 buttons with keys [tonight,this-weekend,next-week,this-month,holiday-sukkot,holiday-pesach,holiday-shavuot,holiday-roshHashana]. Holiday chips have rgb(212,175,55) gold border. Tapping a holiday chip on /stays syncs ?checkin=&checkout=; on /home it NAVIGATES to /stays?checkin=&checkout=. Hebcal cache key is `mir_holiday_windows_v2` — clear it to force a fresh fetch. Today on preview = 2026-06-28 (Sun). Expected holiday dates match: Sukkot 2026-09-25→10-03, Rosh Hashana 2026-09-11→09-13, Pesach 2027-04-21→04-28, Shavuot 2027-06-10→06-11.
